title: Quintessentially Rich French Lamb Confit
description: A rich, molten, and romantic French dish from Lyon, featuring balsamic vinegar and infused oil, suitable for Jain diet.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: preferably with a layer of fat

instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, thyme, and bay leaves.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the lamb shoulder in a clay pot or a heavy-duty Dutch oven.
Cover the clay pot with a lid and place it in the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Strain the braising liquid and discard the thyme and bay leaves.
Serve the lamb with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
